disclaimer: Amounts are transcribed from official/primary sources opened on 14 November 2026 (Pacific/Auckland). No figures were estimated or interpolated. Where a printed table had no dollar sign, the numeric amount is recorded as printed. Hourly equivalents are included only when the official source prints them, or are clearly labelled derived (not official). Base rates exclude penal rates, overtime, units, allowances and employer superannuation unless a source says otherwise.

occupations.name_en: Registered Nurse (Health NZ / NZNO Nursing and Midwifery CA)
occupations.agreement: Health NZ | Te Whatu Ora and NZNO Nursing and Midwifery Collective Agreement
occupations.ordinary_hours_note: Ordinary hours for a full-time employee are 80 per fortnight (clause 6.1). The salary table is printed as annual amounts, not hourly rates.
notes: These are base rates. They exclude penal rates, overtime, PDRP/QLP/merit and other allowances.
Progression: annual increment on anniversary, steps 1 to 5 inclusive; thereafter annual subject to satisfactory performance.
A separate NSNZ Health NZ nursing CA (1 April 2026 to 31 March 2028) also exists on the Health NZ employment-agreements page; its rates were not transcribed in this research.

notes: Step 5 rate as at 2 March 2026 is footnoted in the CA: printed rate includes a 2.5% pay increase and a $2,000 pay-scale adjustment (percentage first, then the flat adjustment).

occupations.agreement: Kindergarten Teachers’, Head Teachers’ and Senior Teachers’ Collective Agreement 2026–2028
occupations.ordinary_hours_note: Printed as annual full-time salaries. A part-time teacher’s salary is paid at 1/40th of the applicable full-time rate (clause 3.8 / part-time provisions). This is the kindergarten-association CA, not the education-and-care pay-parity funding scale.

pending_increase.note: K1 base scale has a further printed increase on 28 January 2027. Head Teachers and Senior Teachers also have 29 June 2026 and 29 June 2027 printed rates.

This covers teachers employed by kindergarten associations who are NZEI members. Most private/community education-and-care ('ECE centre') teachers are not on this CA; they use the MoE pay-parity attestation minimums below.

occupations.name_zh: 专职医疗（物理治疗、社工等，Health NZ / PSA APHST）
occupations.name_en: Allied, Public Health, Scientific and Technical — degree-based core scale (PSA APHST CA)
occupations.agreement: Health NZ | Te Whatu Ora and PSA Allied, Public Health, Scientific & Technical Collective Agreement 2025–2027
occupations.ordinary_hours_note: Clause 5.1: salaries are expressed in full-time forty hour per week rates. Where normal hours are less than 40, salary is a proportion of the 40-hour rate.

pending_increase.note: Printed 7 December 2026 column. As at the research date (14 November 2026) this increase is imminent.

notes: This core scale is the main step scale for degree-qualified allied health roles under this CA, including (among others) physiotherapists, occupational therapists and social workers who are PSA members at Health NZ. Commencing step depends on the minimum professional qualification (Step 1, 2 or 3).
Steps 1–7 progress by annual increment. Step 8 is an Additional Progression Step (objectives). Steps 9–10 are Recognition Steps (Appendix A process).
A Medical Laboratory Scientist intern rate is also printed: $71,070 / $72,847 / $74,304 (2 Sept 2024 / 1 Dec 2025 / 7 Dec 2026).
Non-degree, assistant and several profession-specific scales also exist in this CA and were not fully transcribed here.

Some physiotherapists and social workers are instead covered by APEX collective agreements (for example the APEX physiotherapy CA, 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2027, is listed on the Health NZ employment-agreements page). Those APEX rates were not transcribed in this research. The tool should ask which CA applies.
